name: London System
description: One setup against almost everything: pawns on c3, d4 and e3, with the bishop out to f4 before e3 locks it in. Easy to learn, hard to beat.

lessons.title: The London setup
lessons.summary: The pawn pyramid and where every piece goes.

moves.note: Take the center with the queen's pawn.
Black takes an equal share of the center.
The London move: develop the bishop BEFORE e3, so it isn't stuck behind your pawns.
Black develops naturally.
Now support d4 and open a path for your other bishop.
Black builds a solid wall.
Develop, and keep an eye on e5, a key square in the London.
Black challenges your center from the side.
Complete the pyramid c3-d4-e3. Your d4 pawn is rock solid.
Black adds pressure on d4.
The knight goes to d2, not c3, so it doesn't block your c-pawn.
Black offers to trade off your strong bishop.
Keep the bishop. If Black takes on g3, recapture with the h-pawn and open the h-file.
Black castles.
Your last minor piece takes its best diagonal, aimed at Black's king. Next: castle.

lessons.title: Against the King's Indian setup
lessons.summary: When Black fianchettoes, give your bishop a home with h3.

moves.note: Start with the queen's pawn.
Black keeps options open.
Same London move: bishop out first.
Black prepares to put the bishop on g7.
Build the base of your pyramid.
The fianchettoed bishop aims down the long diagonal at your queenside.
Develop and block that bishop's diagonal.
Black castles quickly.
With no black pawn on d5 to hit, the bishop is solid on e2.
Black prepares ...e5 to kick your bishop.
Give your f4 bishop a retreat on h2, so it can never be trapped or traded off.
Black strikes at d4.
Keep d4 protected by a pawn and finish your setup.

lessons.title: Answering ...c5 and ...Qb6
lessons.summary: Black attacks b2. Offer a queen trade and keep control.

moves.note: Take the center.
Black matches you.
Bishop out first.
Black hits d4 right away.
Support d4. Don't rush to take on c5.
More pressure on d4.
The pyramid again. d4 is now defended twice.
Black's queen attacks b2, which your bishop left unguarded.
Offer a queen trade. If Black takes, recapture with the a-pawn and use the open a-file.
Black kicks your queen and gains space.
Retreat to c2, where the queen helps prepare e4 to open the center.

lessons.title: Against the mirror ...Bf5
lessons.summary: When Black copies you, hit b7 with c4 and Qb3.

moves.note: Take the center.
Black matches you.
Bishop out first.
Black develops.
Support d4.
Black copies your idea and develops the bishop outside the pawn chain.
With Black's bishop gone from c8, b7 is weak. Start by attacking d5.
Black supports d5.
Add another attacker on d5.
Black holds d5 firmly.
Attack b7, which Black's bishop no longer guards.
Black defends and offers a queen trade.
Push past the queen with tempo and grab space on the queenside.
